evidence.excerpt:
# Submit an Application

- [Hilleman Scholars Program](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/)

**Please note your application progress will NOT be automatically saved. Please submit**
**this form once your application is complete.**

This application is open for students starting at MSU in Fall, 2026!

Personal Reference

**Please submit the following information for a personal reference.** This may be a high school teacher, coach, counselor, or another significant influence (but not a family member).

Upon submission of your application, a representative from the MSU Hilleman Scholars Program will contact your reference to provide further instruction on completing the recommendation

Home Responsibilities

Home Responsibilities - Please check all that apply


House Chores - cleaning, laundry, etc

Yard Work - mowing the lawn, raking leaves, etc

Caring for my siblings

Getting siblings ready for school

Helping siblings with school work

Taking care of long-term sick/disabled family member(s)

Managing family finances/budget, paying bills

Taking care of my own child(ren)

Preparing meals for my family

Interpreting or translating for parents

I live on my own/don't live at home - I am self-reliant

\*Other (please explain below)

\*Other

Please provide more detail about your home responsibilities and how that has impacted
your ability to manage your academic work.


Do you work or have you worked for pay outside your home during high school?


Yes

No

Please decribe how your family history and relationships have shaped who you are today.


Have you spent time volunteering in your community or school? Share with us how often
you volunteer and what you've learned through these experiences. If you haven't volunteered,
please explain reasons why.


Essay Question

After reading [Dr. Hilleman's biography](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/biography.html), please write a brief essay (approximately 500-1000 words) describing how his story inspires your own studies at Montana State University. Please also describe your personal aspirations and how you will channel your work ethic to achieve your academic, leadership, and/or career goals.

Essay Question

# Submit an Application

- [Hilleman Scholars Program](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/)

**Please note your application progress will NOT be automatically saved. Please submit**
**this form once your application is complete.**

This application is open for students starting at MSU in Fall, 2026!

Personal Reference

**Please submit the following information for a personal reference.** This may be a high school teacher, coach, counselor, or another significant influence (but not a family member).

Upon submission of your application, a representative from the MSU Hilleman Scholars Program will contact your reference to provide further instruction on completing the recommendation

Home Responsibilities

Home Responsibilities - Please check all that apply


House Chores - cleaning, laundry, etc

Yard Work - mowing the lawn, raking leaves, etc

Caring for my siblings

Getting siblings ready for school

Helping siblings with school work

Taking care of long-term sick/disabled family member(s)

Managing family finances/budget, paying bills

Taking care of my own child(ren)

Preparing meals for my family

Interpreting or translating for parents

I live on my own/don't live at home - I am self-reliant

\*Other (please explain below)

\*Other

Please provide more detail about your home responsibilities and how that has impacted
your ability to manage your academic work.


Do you work or have you worked for pay outside your home during high school?


Yes

No

Please decribe how your family history and relationships have shaped who you are today.


Have you spent time volunteering in your community or school? Share with us how often
you volunteer and what you've learned through these experiences. If you haven't volunteered,
please explain reasons why.


Essay Question

After reading [Dr. Hilleman's biography](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/biography.html), please write a brief essay (approximately 500-1000 words) describing how his story inspires your own studies at Montana State University. Please also describe your personal aspirations and how you will channel your work ethic to achieve your academic, leadership, and/or career goals.

Essay Question

evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

#### Molitoris Leadership Scholarship for Undergraduates

The purpose of the Molitoris Leadership Scholarship is to motivate and reward women who demonstrate leadership in the transportation industry, ensuring that the essential leadership skills and perspectives of women are included in planning the transportation systems of the future. evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

evidence.excerpt:
## Montana Premier Scholarship Program

Many scholarships will be awarded through the **MSU Premier Scholarship** program. These awards will be granted to Montana freshmen who demonstrate academic
promise based upon academic performance.

Montana Premier Scholarship Awards are automatic, merit-based scholarships based upon
a student’s cumulative high school GPA. Award amounts will vary between $1,000 to
$4,000 per year, renewable for four years. All freshmen from Montana who submit an
[application for admission](https://www.montana.edu/apply), complete with cumulative high school GPA provided on the Self Report Formwill be automatically considered. The Premier Award ranges are as follows:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| #### **Cumulative High School GPA** | #### **Montana Premier Scholarship Value** |
| **4.0+** | **$4,000 per year** renewable for four years ($16,000 four-year value) |
| **3.5 - 3.99** | **$3,000 per year** renewable for four years ($12,000 four-year value) |
| **3.0 - 3.49** | **$2,000 per year** renewable for four years ($8,000 four-year value) |
| **2.7 - 2.99** | **$1,000 per year** renewable for four years ($4,000 four-year value) |

All Premier Scholarships are designated for tuition only. Students awarded renewable
Premier Scholarships must maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or greater, enroll for
a minimum of 15 credits per semester, maintain resident status and continuous enrollment
to retain the scholarship throughout their four years at MSU. MSU freshman scholarships
and awards are available to those seeking their first undergraduate bachelor degree
programs only.

Please note that test scores **are not required for consideration.** However, students are encouraged to send us their ACT and/or SAT scores for academic
placement.

# Montana Resident Freshman Scholarships

[image omitted]

**Fall 2027 scholarship information will be available later this fall. Scholarship awards**
**may change each year and are only applicable for the specified year of enrollment.**
**Please check back soon for more information for fall 2027!**

## Fall 2026

## [image omitted] Test Optional

Test scores are no longer required for admission or scholarship consideration at Montana
State University for the foreseeable future. Please note that other academic information,
including a self-reported cumulative GPA, is still required. Students can still submit
ACT/SAT scores for math and writing placement purposes.



If you have taken or are planning to take the ACT/SAT, we invite you to send your
test scores to MSU as they may be utilized for placement into your appropriate math
and writing courses, but they will not be required.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/index.html#mpsp)

## Montana Premier Scholarship Program

Many scholarships will be awarded through the **MSU Premier Scholarship** program. These awards will be granted to Montana freshmen who demonstrate academic
promise based upon academic performance.

Montana Premier Scholarship Awards are automatic, merit-based scholarships based upon
a student’s cumulative high school GPA. Award amounts will vary between $1,000 to
$4,000 per year, renewable for four years. All freshmen from Montana who submit an
[application for admission](https://www.montana.edu/apply), complete with cumulative high school GPA provided on the Self Report Formwill be automatically considered. The Premier Award ranges are as follows:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| #### **Cumulative High School GPA** | #### **Montana Premier Scholarship Value** |
| **4.0+** | **$4,000 per year** renewable for four years ($16,000 four-year value) |
| **3.5 - 3.99** | **$3,000 per year** renewable for four years ($12,000 four-year value) |
| **3.0 - 3.49** | **$2,000 per year** renewable for four years ($8,000 four-year value) |
| **2.7 - 2.99** | **$1,000 per year** renewable for four years ($4,000 four-year value) |

All Premier Scholarships are designated for tuition only. Students awarded renewable
Premier Scholarships must maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or greater, enroll for
a minimum of 15 credits per semester, maintain resident status and continuous enrollment
to retain the scholarship throughout their four years at MSU. MSU freshman scholarships
and awards are available to those seeking their first undergraduate bachelor degree
programs only.

Please note that test scores **are not required for consideration.** However, students are encouraged to send us their ACT and/or SAT scores for academic
placement.

## Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship

Montana State University is excited to continue to support our first-generation Montana
resident students with the Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship. This
award is given to Montana resident students that self-report they are a first-generation
student on their application for admission. This award is valued at **$1,500 per year** and is renewable for four years ($6,000 total value). This award can be stacked on
top of a Montana Premier Scholarship that a student may receive.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/honors/scholarships.html)

## Frequently Asked Questions:

## [Can students accept both Montana University System (MUS) Scholarship and the Premier\  Scholarship?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e529)

The Premier Scholarship is specific to tuition only, so this scholarship cannot stack
with the MUS Honors Scholarship or the Presidential Scholarship. If you are granted
a Premier Scholarship and then receive the Presidential or MUS Honors Scholarship,
we will honor the award of the higher value.

## [Does accepting my current scholarship disqualify me from receiving further aid?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e534)

No. If you accept your current Premier Scholarship offer, that does not disqualify
you from still being considered for the Presidential Scholarship or any greater value
scholarship.

## [Can students update their GPA on file if their academic record changes throughout\  their senior year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e539)

Yes. We evaluate students for scholarships based on their GPA when they apply, but
may be able to reconsider their Premier Scholarship offer if their GPA changes. Please
contact your [Admissions Evaluator](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/staff.html#evaluators) to make updates to your application.

## [Am I considered an incoming transfer student or freshman student if I have attempted\  college-level credit while enrolled in high school (dual-enrollment, AP/IB credit,\  etc.)](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e547)

We consider transfer students to be students that have taken 12 or more college credits **after** graduating high school. If you took college credits while still enrolled in high
school, you will still be considered a freshman and be eligible for freshman scholarships.

## [What happens to my scholarship if I defer for a semester or a year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e554)

Scholarship offers are specific to the start term on your application. We reevaluate
scholarships each year, so you can not defer your scholarship to a later term. If
you defer for a semester or year, you will be reevaluated for scholarships based on
that years parameters.

## [What additional scholarships are available for me to explore?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e559)

Montana State University offers several departmental and college specific scholarships.
Please take a look at our [Cat Scholarships page](https://montana.academicworks.com/) to see all we offer!

evidence.excerpt:
## Montana Premier Scholarship Program

Many scholarships will be awarded through the **MSU Premier Scholarship** program. These awards will be granted to Montana freshmen who demonstrate academic
promise based upon academic performance.

Montana Premier Scholarship Awards are automatic, merit-based scholarships based upon
a student’s cumulative high school GPA. Award amounts will vary between $1,000 to
$4,000 per year, renewable for four years. All freshmen from Montana who submit an
[application for admission](https://www.montana.edu/apply), complete with cumulative high school GPA provided on the Self Report Formwill be automatically considered. The Premier Award ranges are as follows:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| #### **Cumulative High School GPA** | #### **Montana Premier Scholarship Value** |
| **4.0+** | **$4,000 per year** renewable for four years ($16,000 four-year value) |
| **3.5 - 3.99** | **$3,000 per year** renewable for four years ($12,000 four-year value) |
| **3.0 - 3.49** | **$2,000 per year** renewable for four years ($8,000 four-year value) |
| **2.7 - 2.99** | **$1,000 per year** renewable for four years ($4,000 four-year value) |

All Premier Scholarships are designated for tuition only. Students awarded renewable
Premier Scholarships must maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or greater, enroll for
a minimum of 15 credits per semester, maintain resident status and continuous enrollment
to retain the scholarship throughout their four years at MSU. MSU freshman scholarships
and awards are available to those seeking their first undergraduate bachelor degree
programs only.

Please note that test scores **are not required for consideration.** However, students are encouraged to send us their ACT and/or SAT scores for academic
placement.

# Montana Resident Freshman Scholarships

[image omitted]

**Fall 2027 scholarship information will be available later this fall. Scholarship awards**
**may change each year and are only applicable for the specified year of enrollment.**
**Please check back soon for more information for fall 2027!**

## Fall 2026

## [image omitted] Test Optional

Test scores are no longer required for admission or scholarship consideration at Montana
State University for the foreseeable future. Please note that other academic information,
including a self-reported cumulative GPA, is still required. Students can still submit
ACT/SAT scores for math and writing placement purposes.



If you have taken or are planning to take the ACT/SAT, we invite you to send your
test scores to MSU as they may be utilized for placement into your appropriate math
and writing courses, but they will not be required.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/index.html#mpsp)

## Montana Premier Scholarship Program

Many scholarships will be awarded through the **MSU Premier Scholarship** program. These awards will be granted to Montana freshmen who demonstrate academic
promise based upon academic performance.

Montana Premier Scholarship Awards are automatic, merit-based scholarships based upon
a student’s cumulative high school GPA. Award amounts will vary between $1,000 to
$4,000 per year, renewable for four years. All freshmen from Montana who submit an
[application for admission](https://www.montana.edu/apply), complete with cumulative high school GPA provided on the Self Report Formwill be automatically considered. The Premier Award ranges are as follows:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| #### **Cumulative High School GPA** | #### **Montana Premier Scholarship Value** |
| **4.0+** | **$4,000 per year** renewable for four years ($16,000 four-year value) |
| **3.5 - 3.99** | **$3,000 per year** renewable for four years ($12,000 four-year value) |
| **3.0 - 3.49** | **$2,000 per year** renewable for four years ($8,000 four-year value) |
| **2.7 - 2.99** | **$1,000 per year** renewable for four years ($4,000 four-year value) |

All Premier Scholarships are designated for tuition only. Students awarded renewable
Premier Scholarships must maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or greater, enroll for
a minimum of 15 credits per semester, maintain resident status and continuous enrollment
to retain the scholarship throughout their four years at MSU. MSU freshman scholarships
and awards are available to those seeking their first undergraduate bachelor degree
programs only.

Please note that test scores **are not required for consideration.** However, students are encouraged to send us their ACT and/or SAT scores for academic
placement.

## Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship

Montana State University is excited to continue to support our first-generation Montana
resident students with the Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship. This
award is given to Montana resident students that self-report they are a first-generation
student on their application for admission. This award is valued at **$1,500 per year** and is renewable for four years ($6,000 total value). This award can be stacked on
top of a Montana Premier Scholarship that a student may receive.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/honors/scholarships.html)

## Frequently Asked Questions:

## [Can students accept both Montana University System (MUS) Scholarship and the Premier\  Scholarship?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e529)

The Premier Scholarship is specific to tuition only, so this scholarship cannot stack
with the MUS Honors Scholarship or the Presidential Scholarship. If you are granted
a Premier Scholarship and then receive the Presidential or MUS Honors Scholarship,
we will honor the award of the higher value.

## [Does accepting my current scholarship disqualify me from receiving further aid?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e534)

No. If you accept your current Premier Scholarship offer, that does not disqualify
you from still being considered for the Presidential Scholarship or any greater value
scholarship.

## [Can students update their GPA on file if their academic record changes throughout\  their senior year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e539)

Yes. We evaluate students for scholarships based on their GPA when they apply, but
may be able to reconsider their Premier Scholarship offer if their GPA changes. Please
contact your [Admissions Evaluator](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/staff.html#evaluators) to make updates to your application.

## [Am I considered an incoming transfer student or freshman student if I have attempted\  college-level credit while enrolled in high school (dual-enrollment, AP/IB credit,\  etc.)](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e547)

We consider transfer students to be students that have taken 12 or more college credits **after** graduating high school. If you took college credits while still enrolled in high
school, you will still be considered a freshman and be eligible for freshman scholarships.

## [What happens to my scholarship if I defer for a semester or a year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e554)

Scholarship offers are specific to the start term on your application. We reevaluate
scholarships each year, so you can not defer your scholarship to a later term. If
you defer for a semester or year, you will be reevaluated for scholarships based on
that years parameters.

## [What additional scholarships are available for me to explore?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e559)

Montana State University offers several departmental and college specific scholarships.
Please take a look at our [Cat Scholarships page](https://montana.academicworks.com/) to see all we offer!

* * *

evidence.excerpt:
# Montana Resident Freshman Scholarships

[image omitted]

**Fall 2027 scholarship information will be available later this fall. Scholarship awards**
**may change each year and are only applicable for the specified year of enrollment.**
**Please check back soon for more information for fall 2027!**

## Fall 2026

## [image omitted] Test Optional

Test scores are no longer required for admission or scholarship consideration at Montana
State University for the foreseeable future. Please note that other academic information,
including a self-reported cumulative GPA, is still required. Students can still submit
ACT/SAT scores for math and writing placement purposes.



If you have taken or are planning to take the ACT/SAT, we invite you to send your
test scores to MSU as they may be utilized for placement into your appropriate math
and writing courses, but they will not be required.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/index.html#mpsp)

## Montana Premier Scholarship Program

Many scholarships will be awarded through the **MSU Premier Scholarship** program. These awards will be granted to Montana freshmen who demonstrate academic
promise based upon academic performance.

Montana Premier Scholarship Awards are automatic, merit-based scholarships based upon
a student’s cumulative high school GPA. Award amounts will vary between $1,000 to
$4,000 per year, renewable for four years. All freshmen from Montana who submit an
[application for admission](https://www.montana.edu/apply), complete with cumulative high school GPA provided on the Self Report Formwill be automatically considered. The Premier Award ranges are as follows:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| #### **Cumulative High School GPA** | #### **Montana Premier Scholarship Value** |
| **4.0+** | **$4,000 per year** renewable for four years ($16,000 four-year value) |
| **3.5 - 3.99** | **$3,000 per year** renewable for four years ($12,000 four-year value) |
| **3.0 - 3.49** | **$2,000 per year** renewable for four years ($8,000 four-year value) |
| **2.7 - 2.99** | **$1,000 per year** renewable for four years ($4,000 four-year value) |

All Premier Scholarships are designated for tuition only. Students awarded renewable
Premier Scholarships must maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or greater, enroll for
a minimum of 15 credits per semester, maintain resident status and continuous enrollment
to retain the scholarship throughout their four years at MSU. MSU freshman scholarships
and awards are available to those seeking their first undergraduate bachelor degree
programs only.

Please note that test scores **are not required for consideration.** However, students are encouraged to send us their ACT and/or SAT scores for academic
placement.

## Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship

Montana State University is excited to continue to support our first-generation Montana
resident students with the Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship. This
award is given to Montana resident students that self-report they are a first-generation
student on their application for admission. This award is valued at **$1,500 per year** and is renewable for four years ($6,000 total value). This award can be stacked on
top of a Montana Premier Scholarship that a student may receive.

[[image omitted]](https://www.montana.edu/honors/scholarships.html)

## Frequently Asked Questions:

## [Can students accept both Montana University System (MUS) Scholarship and the Premier\  Scholarship?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e529)

The Premier Scholarship is specific to tuition only, so this scholarship cannot stack
with the MUS Honors Scholarship or the Presidential Scholarship. If you are granted
a Premier Scholarship and then receive the Presidential or MUS Honors Scholarship,
we will honor the award of the higher value.

## [Does accepting my current scholarship disqualify me from receiving further aid?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e534)

No. If you accept your current Premier Scholarship offer, that does not disqualify
you from still being considered for the Presidential Scholarship or any greater value
scholarship.

## [Can students update their GPA on file if their academic record changes throughout\  their senior year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e539)

Yes. We evaluate students for scholarships based on their GPA when they apply, but
may be able to reconsider their Premier Scholarship offer if their GPA changes. Please
contact your [Admissions Evaluator](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/staff.html#evaluators) to make updates to your application.

## [Am I considered an incoming transfer student or freshman student if I have attempted\  college-level credit while enrolled in high school (dual-enrollment, AP/IB credit,\  etc.)](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e547)

We consider transfer students to be students that have taken 12 or more college credits **after** graduating high school. If you took college credits while still enrolled in high
school, you will still be considered a freshman and be eligible for freshman scholarships.

## [What happens to my scholarship if I defer for a semester or a year?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e554)

Scholarship offers are specific to the start term on your application. We reevaluate
scholarships each year, so you can not defer your scholarship to a later term. If
you defer for a semester or year, you will be reevaluated for scholarships based on
that years parameters.

## [What additional scholarships are available for me to explore?](https://www.montana.edu/admissions/scholarships/residents/\#collapsed84e515_d84e559)

Montana State University offers several departmental and college specific scholarships.
Please take a look at our [Cat Scholarships page](https://montana.academicworks.com/) to see all we offer!

## Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship

Montana State University is excited to continue to support our first-generation Montana
resident students with the Montana Treasure State First Generation Scholarship. This
award is given to Montana resident students that self-report they are a first-generation
student on their application for admission. This award is valued at **$1,500 per year** and is renewable for four years ($6,000 total value). This award can be stacked on
top of a Montana Premier Scholarship that a student may receive.

National Merit Scholarships

The University of Montana participates in the National Merit Scholarship Program and offers awards of $2,000 a year to finalists who have indicated UM as their first choice for attending college. Semi-finalists who enroll at UM will receive an award of $1,000 a year. Awards under this program may be held in addition to the Presidential Leadership Scholarship and departmental scholarships.

evidence.excerpt:
### Scholarship Application Timelines

New students are automatically evaluated for the merit-based scholarships when they apply. In order to be considered for incoming merit scholarships, students must apply for admission by **July 1**. Scholarship priority will be given to those who apply by this date.

It is best to begin researching scholarship opportunities in the fall for the following academic year as the majority of scholarship applications have a winter deadline.

# New/Incoming Students

Several scholarship opportunities exist for incoming students at the University of Montana. Students are automatically considered for many these scholarships when they apply for admission. Learn more about specific scholarship opportunities by visiting the pages listed below.

Undergraduate and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for the University of Montana Academic Achievement Scholarship (UMAAS). Students are automatically considered for this merit scholarship when they apply for admission.

Montana undergraduate and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for an admissions scholarship and are automatically considered when they apply for admission.

The Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE) tuition discount is a merit-based tuition discount, and the University of Montana’s highest award for incoming students from WUE-eligible states.

Students with demonstrated financial need may be eligible for a UM Need Grant.

# 2027 WTS Strategic Partner Scholarships Are Open!

**The 2027 WTS International Annual Conference: A Monumental 50th will be held May 4-6, 2027 at the [Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC](https://www.omnihotels.com/hotels/washington-dc-shoreham).** We are seeking nominations for the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate PartnerScholarships](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). In 2027, six $5,000 scholarships are available through the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate Partners](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). These scholarships support the [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation)'s development of students in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals and students to undertake careers in transportation. Strategic Partner Scholarships are available thanks to the generosity of HNTB, AECOM, HDR, Jacobs, and WSP. Winners of the 2027 Strategic Partner Scholarships will be invited as special guests to the WTS International Annual Conference and will accept their scholarship on stage at the WTS Foundation Gala in Washington, DC in May 2027.

**Criteria**

The **minimum criteria** to apply include:

- Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at the time of application.
- GPA of 3.0 or higher.
- Currently enrolled in a transportation-related field, such as engineering, planning, finance, construction/project management or logistics.
- Plans to pursue a career in a transportation-related field.

Strong applications will highlight the students’ leadership and engagement in their chosen field of study, present a compelling personal statement, and include references that demonstrate strong support for the candidate. **Applications close on Friday, December 11**.

[Apply for Scholarships](https://www.abstractscorecard.com/cfp/submit/login.asp[query-withheld])

### Strategic Partner Scholarships

These scholarships are sponsored by WTS International [**Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate Partners**](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners) and support the Foundation's development of students in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals and students to undertake careers in transportation. In 2026, seven $5,000 corporate Strategic Partner Scholarships were available thanks to the generosity of [HNTB](https://www.hntb.com/), [HDR](https://www.hdrinc.com/), [AECOM](https://www.aecom.com/), [<PRIVATE_PERSON>](https://www.jacobs.com/), and [WSP](https://www.wsp.com/en-us).

[Apply for 2027 Strategic Partner Scholarships](https://www.wtsinternational.org/news/wts-strategic-partner-scholarships)

### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

#### <PRIVATE_PERSON> Memorial Undergraduate Scholarship

This scholarship in the amount of $5,000 is awarded to women pursuing undergraduate studies in transportation or a related field [remaining biography omitted]

#### Molitoris Leadership Scholarship for Undergraduates

The purpose of the Molitoris Leadership Scholarship is to motivate and reward women who demonstrate leadership in the transportation industry, ensuring that the essential leadership skills and perspectives of women are included in planning the transportation systems of the future. Leadership does not just happen. Leaders personally invest and risk much. They take on struggles that many would avoid and persevere to reach successful outcomes. These qualities receive special attention in the selection of the winner of this $5,000 award.

#### Junior College/Trade School Scholarship

WTS fosters the development of women in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals to undertake careers in transportation. One way we achieve this is by awarding community, technical, or trade college scholarships to women pursuing transportation-related study at community and trade colleges. This scholarship, intended for students pursuing an Associate or technical degree, is in the amount of $2,500.

#### WTS Transportation YOU High School Scholarship

WTS awards the Transportation YOU Scholarship to girls pursuing high school studies in science, technology, engineering, and math to foster the development of women and girls in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals and students to undertake careers in transportation. The Transportation YOU High School Scholarship is in the amount of $2,500.

# 2027 WTS Strategic Partner Scholarships Are Open!

**The 2027 WTS International Annual Conference: A Monumental 50th will be held May 4-6, 2027 at the [Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC](https://www.omnihotels.com/hotels/washington-dc-shoreham).** We are seeking nominations for the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate PartnerScholarships](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). In 2027, six $5,000 scholarships are available through the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate Partners](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). These scholarships support the [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation)'s development of students in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals and students to undertake careers in transportation. Strategic Partner Scholarships are available thanks to the generosity of HNTB, AECOM, HDR, Jacobs, and WSP. Winners of the 2027 Strategic Partner Scholarships will be invited as special guests to the WTS International Annual Conference and will accept their scholarship on stage at the WTS Foundation Gala in Washington, DC in May 2027.

**Criteria**

The **minimum criteria** to apply include:

- Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at the time of application.
- GPA of 3.0 or higher.
- Currently enrolled in a transportation-related field, such as engineering, planning, finance, construction/project management or logistics.
- Plans to pursue a career in a transportation-related field.

Strong applications will highlight the students’ leadership and engagement in their chosen field of study, present a compelling personal statement, and include references that demonstrate strong support for the candidate. **Applications close on Friday, December 11**.

[Apply for Scholarships](https://www.abstractscorecard.com/cfp/submit/login.asp[query-withheld])

**The 2027 WTS International Annual Conference: A Monumental 50th will be held May 4-6, 2027 at the [Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC](https://www.omnihotels.com/hotels/washington-dc-shoreham).** We are seeking nominations for the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate PartnerScholarships](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). - Plans to pursue a career in a transportation-related field.

Strong applications will highlight the students’ leadership and engagement in their chosen field of study, present a compelling personal statement, and include references that demonstrate strong support for the candidate. **Applications close on Friday, December 11**.

evidence.excerpt:
# 2027 WTS Strategic Partner Scholarships Are Open!

**The 2027 WTS International Annual Conference: A Monumental 50th will be held May 4-6, 2027 at the [Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC](https://www.omnihotels.com/hotels/washington-dc-shoreham).** We are seeking nominations for the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate PartnerScholarships](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). In 2027, six $5,000 scholarships are available through the [WTS International Pinnacle and Strategic Level Corporate Partners](https://www.wtsinternational.org/resources/corporate-partners). These scholarships support the [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation)'s development of students in the transportation field by encouraging bright new professionals and students to undertake careers in transportation. Strategic Partner Scholarships are available thanks to the generosity of HNTB, AECOM, HDR, Jacobs, and WSP. Winners of the 2027 Strategic Partner Scholarships will be invited as special guests to the WTS International Annual Conference and will accept their scholarship on stage at the WTS Foundation Gala in Washington, DC in May 2027.

**Criteria**

The **minimum criteria** to apply include:

- Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at the time of application.
- GPA of 3.0 or higher.
- Currently enrolled in a transportation-related field, such as engineering, planning, finance, construction/project management or logistics.
- Plans to pursue a career in a transportation-related field.

Strong applications will highlight the students’ leadership and engagement in their chosen field of study, present a compelling personal statement, and include references that demonstrate strong support for the candidate. **Applications close on Friday, December 11**.

[Apply for Scholarships](https://www.abstractscorecard.com/cfp/submit/login.asp[query-withheld])

evidence.excerpt:
## Community Scholarship Opportunities

The Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation supports high school and college students with dyslexia who wish to pursue a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) field.

[Learn More(opens in new tab)](https://morelli.foundation/scholarship/)

As of December 31, 2025, the Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation is dissolving and transferring to Montana State University, who is endowing a scholarship for Joseph James Morelli Scholars, students pursuing an education in STEM, in perpetuity. Starting in 2026, the scholarship is only available to students attending MSU.

## Expanded Scholarships and Support

MSU will continue the remarkable efforts of Joseph James Legacy Foundation by awarding the Hilleman/Morelli Scholarship.  This 4-year scholarship provides a unique blend of financial, academic, leadership, and mentoring support for students.  Beyond demonstrating learning differences, Hilleman/Morelli scholars will be selected on their academic, leadership, and career potential.

To apply or learn more about this Hilleman/Morelli scholarship, please visit the [Hilleman Scholars Application page](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/apply.html) for more information

evidence.excerpt:
As of December 31, 2025, the Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation is dissolving and transferring to Montana State University, who is endowing a scholarship for Joseph James Morelli Scholars, students pursuing an education in STEM, in perpetuity. Starting in 2026, the scholarship is only available to students attending MSU.

## Expanded Scholarships and Support

MSU will continue the remarkable efforts of Joseph James Legacy Foundation by awarding the Hilleman/Morelli Scholarship.  This 4-year scholarship provides a unique blend of financial, academic, leadership, and mentoring support for students.  Beyond demonstrating learning differences, Hilleman/Morelli scholars will be selected on their academic, leadership, and career potential.

To apply or learn more about this Hilleman/Morelli scholarship, please visit the [Hilleman Scholars Application page](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/apply.html) for more information

evidence.excerpt:
## UMAAS: UM's Merit-Based Scholarship Undergraduates and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for the University of Montana Academic Achievement Scholarship (UMAAS). Students are automatically considered for this merit scholarship when they apply for admission. ## UMAAS Amounts | High School GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.95+ | $18,000 | | 3.75 to 3.949 | $16,000 | | 3.34 to 3.749 | $14,000 | | 3.00 to 3.349 | $12,500 | | 2.99 and below | $5,000 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on high school GPA | Transfer GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.5+ | $12,500 | | 3.25 to 3.49 | $10,000 | | 3.00 to 3.249 | $5,000 | | 2.99 and below | $0 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on transfer GPA ## UMAAS Details The UMAAS is a _tuition‑designated_ scholarship, meaning it can only be applied to tuition costs. It cannot be combined with any other full‑tuition waiver. If a student receives multiple tuition-designated awards, the total of all tuition waivers cannot exceed the cost of tuition. Students who receive another tuition waiver or third- party tuition coverage should expect their UMAAS to be reduced or canceled in accordance with University of Montana award‑stacking policies. The University of Montana may substitute or replace a student’s UMAAS with other UM scholarship funds when needed to meet institutional policy, donor intent or scholarship‑stacking requirements. This ensures compliance with all awarding rules while maximizing each student’s eligibility for institutional support. Applicants must submit an unofficial copy of their high school transcript in order to receive UMAAS. Any merit scholarship offer is preliminary and cannot be officially offered until this step is complete. To maximize grant and scholarship opportunities, new students are also encouraged to [complete the FAFSA](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/_archive/financial-aid/apply-for-financial-aid/fafsa/default.php), and apply for departmental and renewable scholarships through [Scholarship Universe](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php). Students who do not qualify for UMAAS upon entry to UM but choose to attend anyway cannot qualify for UMAAS at a later date. However, they are encouraged to apply for [continuing student scholarships](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php "Continuing Student Scholarshps"). # UMAAS Renewability Criteria | Renewal Criteria | Started Fall 2025 or After | Started Before Fall 2025 | | --- | --- | --- | | Minimum Cumulative GPA (end of spring) | 2.5 | 2.5 | | Minimum Credits per Semester | 15 credits/semester | 12 credits/semester | | Minimum Credits per Academic Year | 30 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | 24 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | | Enrollment Requirement | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | | Summer Term Eligibility | Not available for summer | Not available for summer | | Missoula/Bitterroot College Transfer | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Online-Only Students | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Montana Residency (OOS students) | Available for MT residents | Available for MT residents | | Post-Baccalaureate / Graduate Students | Not eligible | Not eligible | | Maximum Duration | 4 years | 4 years | | Transfer Student Award Eligibility Remaining | 0–29 credits: 4 years

## UMAAS: UM's Merit-Based Scholarship Undergraduates and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for the University of Montana Academic Achievement Scholarship (UMAAS). Students are automatically considered for this merit scholarship when they apply for admission. ## UMAAS Amounts | High School GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.95+ | $18,000 | | 3.75 to 3.949 | $16,000 | | 3.34 to 3.749 | $14,000 | | 3.00 to 3.349 | $12,500 | | 2.99 and below | $5,000 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on high school GPA | Transfer GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.5+ | $12,500 | | 3.25 to 3.49 | $10,000 | | 3.00 to 3.249 | $5,000 | | 2.99 and below | $0 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on transfer GPA ## UMAAS Details The UMAAS is a _tuition‑designated_ scholarship, meaning it can only be applied to tuition costs. It cannot be combined with any other full‑tuition waiver. If a student receives multiple tuition-designated awards, the total of all tuition waivers cannot exceed the cost of tuition. Students who receive another tuition waiver or third- party tuition coverage should expect their UMAAS to be reduced or canceled in accordance with University of Montana award‑stacking policies. The University of Montana may substitute or replace a student’s UMAAS with other UM scholarship funds when needed to meet institutional policy, donor intent or scholarship‑stacking requirements. This ensures compliance with all awarding rules while maximizing each student’s eligibility for institutional support. Applicants must submit an unofficial copy of their high school transcript in order to receive UMAAS. Any merit scholarship offer is preliminary and cannot be officially offered until this step is complete. To maximize grant and scholarship opportunities, new students are also encouraged to [complete the FAFSA](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/_archive/financial-aid/apply-for-financial-aid/fafsa/default.php), and apply for departmental and renewable scholarships through [Scholarship Universe](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php). Students who do not qualify for UMAAS upon entry to UM but choose to attend anyway cannot qualify for UMAAS at a later date. However, they are encouraged to apply for [continuing student scholarships](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php "Continuing Student Scholarshps"). # UMAAS Renewability Criteria | Renewal Criteria | Started Fall 2025 or After | Started Before Fall 2025 | | --- | --- | --- | | Minimum Cumulative GPA (end of spring) | 2.5 | 2.5 | | Minimum Credits per Semester | 15 credits/semester | 12 credits/semester | | Minimum Credits per Academic Year | 30 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | 24 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | | Enrollment Requirement | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | | Summer Term Eligibility | Not available for summer | Not available for summer | | Missoula/Bitterroot College Transfer | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Online-Only Students | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Montana Residency (OOS students) | Available for MT residents | Available for MT residents | | Post-Baccalaureate / Graduate Students | Not eligible | Not eligible | | Maximum Duration | 4 years | 4 years | | Transfer Student Award Eligibility Remaining | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | | Completion of Bachelor's Degree | Lose eligibility upon completion | Lose eligibility upon completion | | Appeal Process | Scholarship Appeal Form available | Scholarship Appeal Form available | UMAAS scholarship renewal criteria compared by student start term: Fall 2025 or after versus before Fall 2025

## UMAAS: UM's Merit-Based Scholarship Undergraduates and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for the University of Montana Academic Achievement Scholarship (UMAAS). Students are automatically considered for this merit scholarship when they apply for admission. ## UMAAS Amounts | High School GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.95+ | $18,000 | | 3.75 to 3.949 | $16,000 | | 3.34 to 3.749 | $14,000 | | 3.00 to 3.349 | $12,500 | | 2.99 and below | $5,000 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on high school GPA | Transfer GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.5+ | $12,500 | | 3.25 to 3.49 | $10,000 | | 3.00 to 3.249 | $5,000 | | 2.99 and below | $0 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on transfer GPA ## UMAAS Details The UMAAS is a _tuition‑designated_ scholarship, meaning it can only be applied to tuition costs. It cannot be combined with any other full‑tuition waiver. If a student receives multiple tuition-designated awards, the total of all tuition waivers cannot exceed the cost of tuition. Students who receive another tuition waiver or third- party tuition coverage should expect their UMAAS to be reduced or canceled in accordance with University of Montana award‑stacking policies. The University of Montana may substitute or replace a student’s UMAAS with other UM scholarship funds when needed to meet institutional policy, donor intent or scholarship‑stacking requirements. This ensures compliance with all awarding rules while maximizing each student’s eligibility for institutional support. Applicants must submit an unofficial copy of their high school transcript in order to receive UMAAS. Any merit scholarship offer is preliminary and cannot be officially offered until this step is complete. To maximize grant and scholarship opportunities, new students are also encouraged to [complete the FAFSA](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/_archive/financial-aid/apply-for-financial-aid/fafsa/default.php), and apply for departmental and renewable scholarships through [Scholarship Universe](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php). Students who do not qualify for UMAAS upon entry to UM but choose to attend anyway cannot qualify for UMAAS at a later date. However, they are encouraged to apply for [continuing student scholarships](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php "Continuing Student Scholarshps"). # UMAAS Renewability Criteria | Renewal Criteria | Started Fall 2025 or After | Started Before Fall 2025 | | --- | --- | --- | | Minimum Cumulative GPA (end of spring) | 2.5 | 2.5 | | Minimum Credits per Semester | 15 credits/semester | 12 credits/semester | | Minimum Credits per Academic Year | 30 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | 24 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | | Enrollment Requirement | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | | Summer Term Eligibility | Not available for summer | Not available for summer | | Missoula/Bitterroot College Transfer | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Online-Only Students | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Montana Residency (OOS students) | Available for MT residents | Available for MT residents | | Post-Baccalaureate / Graduate Students | Not eligible | Not eligible | | Maximum Duration | 4 years | 4 years | | Transfer Student Award Eligibility Remaining | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | | Completion of Bachelor's Degree | Lose eligibility upon completion | Lose eligibility upon completion | | Appeal Process | Scholarship Appeal Form available | Scholarship Appeal Form available | UMAAS scholarship renewal criteria compared by student start term: Fall 2025 or after versus before Fall 2025

evidence.excerpt:
## UMAAS: UM's Merit-Based Scholarship Undergraduates and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree are eligible for the University of Montana Academic Achievement Scholarship (UMAAS). Students are automatically considered for this merit scholarship when they apply for admission. ## UMAAS Amounts | High School GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.95+ | $18,000 | | 3.75 to 3.949 | $16,000 | | 3.34 to 3.749 | $14,000 | | 3.00 to 3.349 | $12,500 | | 2.99 and below | $5,000 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on high school GPA | Transfer GPA | Scholarship Amount | | --- | --- | | 3.5+ | $12,500 | | 3.25 to 3.49 | $10,000 | | 3.00 to 3.249 | $5,000 | | 2.99 and below | $0 | UM Academic Achievement Scholarship amounts available based on transfer GPA ## UMAAS Details The UMAAS is a _tuition‑designated_ scholarship, meaning it can only be applied to tuition costs. It cannot be combined with any other full‑tuition waiver. If a student receives multiple tuition-designated awards, the total of all tuition waivers cannot exceed the cost of tuition. Students who receive another tuition waiver or third- party tuition coverage should expect their UMAAS to be reduced or canceled in accordance with University of Montana award‑stacking policies. The University of Montana may substitute or replace a student’s UMAAS with other UM scholarship funds when needed to meet institutional policy, donor intent or scholarship‑stacking requirements. This ensures compliance with all awarding rules while maximizing each student’s eligibility for institutional support. Applicants must submit an unofficial copy of their high school transcript in order to receive UMAAS. Any merit scholarship offer is preliminary and cannot be officially offered until this step is complete. To maximize grant and scholarship opportunities, new students are also encouraged to [complete the FAFSA](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/_archive/financial-aid/apply-for-financial-aid/fafsa/default.php), and apply for departmental and renewable scholarships through [Scholarship Universe](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php). Students who do not qualify for UMAAS upon entry to UM but choose to attend anyway cannot qualify for UMAAS at a later date. However, they are encouraged to apply for [continuing student scholarships](https://www.umt.edu/student-financial-services/scholarships/apply-for-scholarships.php "Continuing Student Scholarshps"). # UMAAS Renewability Criteria | Renewal Criteria | Started Fall 2025 or After | Started Before Fall 2025 | | --- | --- | --- | | Minimum Cumulative GPA (end of spring) | 2.5 | 2.5 | | Minimum Credits per Semester | 15 credits/semester | 12 credits/semester | | Minimum Credits per Academic Year | 30 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | 24 credits
(fall, spring & summer) | | Enrollment Requirement | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | Must be continuously enrolled (Exception: Summer Term) | | Summer Term Eligibility | Not available for summer | Not available for summer | | Missoula/Bitterroot College Transfer | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Online-Only Students | Forfeit scholarship | Forfeit scholarship | | Montana Residency (OOS students) | Available for MT residents | Available for MT residents | | Post-Baccalaureate / Graduate Students | Not eligible | Not eligible | | Maximum Duration | 4 years | 4 years | | Transfer Student Award Eligibility Remaining | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | 0–29 credits: 4 years
30–59 credits: 3 years
60+ credits: 2 years | | Completion of Bachelor's Degree | Lose eligibility upon completion | Lose eligibility upon completion | | Appeal Process | Scholarship Appeal Form available | Scholarship Appeal Form available | UMAAS scholarship renewal criteria compared by student start term: Fall 2025 or after versus before Fall 2025

### Scholarship Application Timelines

New students are automatically evaluated for the merit-based scholarships when they apply. In order to be considered for incoming merit scholarships, students must apply for admission by **July 1**. Scholarship priority will be given to those who apply by this date.

It is best to begin researching scholarship opportunities in the fall for the following academic year as the majority of scholarship applications have a winter deadline.

evidence.excerpt:
## _Workforce Development Scholarships_

In 2015, the National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) and its Build Your Future initiative made a generous contribution to help fund the first Workforce Development scholarships for students pursuing craft and technical programs, allowing 19 applicants to receive the inaugural scholarships.  Scholarships are $1,000 per year, renewable for up to two years. The 2027-2028 Workforce Development Scholarship program will open March 1, 2027.

To see if there is also a local scholarship program sponsored by the AGC Chapter in your home state or the state in which your school is located, [click here](https://www.agc.org/connect/chapters) to find contact information for chapters across the nation.

evidence.excerpt:
## _Workforce Development Scholarships_

In 2015, the National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) and its Build Your Future initiative made a generous contribution to help fund the first Workforce Development scholarships for students pursuing craft and technical programs, allowing 19 applicants to receive the inaugural scholarships.  Scholarships are $1,000 per year, renewable for up to two years. The 2027-2028 Workforce Development Scholarship program will open March 1, 2027.

To see if there is also a local scholarship program sponsored by the AGC Chapter in your home state or the state in which your school is located, [click here](https://www.agc.org/connect/chapters) to find contact information for chapters across the nation.

evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

evidence.excerpt:
### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

### WTS Foundation Scholarships

The [WTS Foundation](https://www.wtsinternational.org/wts-foundation) awards scholarships to students pursuing careers in transportation through undergraduate and graduate programs. The scholarships are competitive and based on the applicant's specific transportation goals, academic record and transportation-related activities or job skills. Minority candidates are encouraged to apply.

#### The 2027 WTS Foundation Scholarships will open December 14, 2026!

The scholarships named below are awarded first at the [WTS Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) level.  Winners at the Chapter level are submitted to the WTS Foundation on an annual basis for consideration, with winners announced in May of the following year at the [WTS International Annual Conference](https://www.wtsinternational.org/about/www.wtsannualconference.org).

- [Considerations for Scholarship Distribution to Encourage Diverse Applicants](https://higherlogicdownload.s3.amazonaws.com/WTSINTERNATIONAL/2cadead5-b2b4-4748-b018-b2a00f0ba19e/UploadedImages/Considerations_for_Scholarship_Distribution_to_Encourage_Diverse_Applicants.pdf)
- [Scholarship Evaluation Guidelines](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])
- [Scholarship Application Coversheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx[query-withheld])

Local Chapters may have additional requirements (such as personal interviews or higher GPA). [Please contact your local Chapter](https://www.wtsinternational.org/chapters) for more information regarding any additional requirements. All applications are submitted through a chapter, and chapters submit their nominations for consideration to a Selection Committee composed of Foundation Board members.

evidence.excerpt:
## All-American Pest Control STEAM Trailblazer Scholarship

We are thrilled to announce the launch of the All-American Pest Control STEAM Trailblazer Scholarship, an incredible opportunity for young women who are blazing trails in the world of Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM). Are you ready to seize the spotlight and be a driving force of change? This scholarship is dedicated to YOU! Those who are not just dreaming but taking action.

#### Applications for 2026 are opening October 1st!

**Applications Open:** October 1, 2026

**Applications Close:** November 30, 2026

**Recipient Announced:** mid-January 2027

**Award:** $1,000 for one exceptional individual!

#### Eligibility

- Applicants must be female and be currently enrolled as high school seniors or college/trade school students in an accredited institution within the United States.

- Students must demonstrate a strong commitment to All-American Pest Control’s core values of servant leadership, thoughtful innovation, respectfulness, teamwork and reliability in their academic pursuits, extracurricular activities and community involvement.

- Candidates should have a genuine passion for STEAM fields and actively pursue or plan a career in a STEAM-related discipline.

- A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is required.


#### Application Requirements

Interested applicants must submit all requirements found on the scholarship program's [official website](https://www.npmapestworld.org/content-pages/scholarships/all-american-pest-control-steam-trailblazer-scholarship/) to apply for this scholarship. The application will require the following:

- Personal Information: Provide basic details such as full name, contact information and educational background.

- Essay OR Video Submission: Write an inspiring essay of approximately 500-1,000 words OR produce a 2-3 minute video explaining your passion for STEAM fields, your STEAM accomplishments, your career aspirations and how you have demonstrated one of All-American Pest Control’s core values of servant leadership, thoughtful innovation, respectfulness, teamwork or reliability in your academic, personal and/or community life.

- Letter of Recommendation: Submit one letter of recommendation from an individual who can attest to your academic abilities, character and commitment to STEAM disciplines.

- Transcript: Provide an official copy of your most recent academic transcript.


#### Scholarship Details

The All-American Pest Control STEAM Trailblazer Scholarship is more than an award. Our platform is dedicated to uplifting young women who encapsulate servant leadership, thoughtful innovation, respect, teamwork, and reliability. We're not just supporting STEAM; we're championing the future innovators who dare to make a difference. Our aim is to celebrate and support one remarkable female individual as they pursue a career in STEAM.

## All-American Pest Control STEAM Trailblazer Scholarship

The Pest Management Foundation has a number of scholarships for students. The application period is now open! Scholarship applications are accepted from October 1st through November 30th each year. Scholarship recipients will be notified in mid-January.

[Apply for Scholarships](https://pmf.secure-platform.com/a/solicitations/login/102011[query-withheld])

**Donor: All-American Pest**

**Award Amount: One (1) award per year totaling $1,000**

The All-American Pest Control STEAM Trailblazer Scholarship is a distinguished program that honors and empowers outstanding young women with a drive to excel in science, technology, engineering, arts, or mathematics (STEAM). This scholarship is a platform to uplift young women who embody All-Americans’ core values of servant leadership, thoughtful innovation, respectfulness, teamwork, and reliability while nurturing their passion for STEAM education. All-American Pest Control is a female-led company, and we aim to celebrate and support one remarkable female individual as they pursue a career in STEAM.

**Scholarship Criteria**

- Applicants must be female and be currently enrolled as high school seniors or college/trade school students in an accredited institution within the United States.
- Students must demonstrate a strong commitment to All-American’s core values of servant leadership, thoughtful innovation, respectfulness, teamwork and reliability in their academic pursuits, extracurricular activities and community involvement.
- Candidates should have a genuine passion for STEAM fields and actively pursue or plan a career in a STEAM-related discipline.
- A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is required.
- Recipients must commit to writing a letter of appreciation outlining how the scholarship has helped them in their academic endeavors.

**Application Submission Requirements**

- Resume or curriculum vita.
- Current academic transcript.
- A one-page (minimum) essay or video (2-3 minutes) describing the applicant's passion for STEAM fields, STEAM accomplishments, career aspirations, and how the applicant has demonstrated one of All-American Pest Control’s core values of servant leadership, thoughtful innovation or teamwork in your academic, personal, and/or community life.
- At least one (1) letter of recommendation from individuals who can speak to the applicant’s character, commitment to STEAM disciplines, and work ethic
